name: AKS
summary: Azure Kubernetes Service cluster with a private API server, Entra ID RBAC only, workload identity federation and the Key Vault Secrets Provider on by default.
useWhen: You need Kubernetes for full orchestration control, custom operators or an existing Helm/K8s-native toolchain
You're running many services that benefit from a shared cluster's autoscaling and scheduling
avoidWhen: Container Apps meets the need with far less operational overhead (no node management, no cluster upgrades)
You're running a single container or job (use Container Apps or Container Instances)
